name: GL_CALENDARS_
description: Unique identifier for accounting and commitment Calendars created in Oracle Fusion and has a one to one relationship with PERIOD_SET_NAME. For legacy accounting calendars migrated from instances prior to Oracle Fusion, CALENDAR_ID may have a one to many relationship with PERIOD_SET_NAME.

columns.name: CALENDAR_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for Accounting and Commitment Calendars created in Fusion and has a 1-1 Relationship with PERIOD_SET_NAME. For legacy Accounting Calendars migrated from instances prior to Fusion, CALENDAR_ID may have 1 to many relationship with PERIOD_SET_NAME.

columns.name: USER_PERIOD_SET_NAME
columns.description: Period of time, extending from one date to another, defined by a party to quantify the fiscal position of the business. It can be divided into accounting periods.

columns.name: PERIOD_SET_NAME
columns.description: Name of the accounting calendar.

columns.name: PERIOD_SET_ID
columns.description: Accounting calendar identifier.

columns.name: PERIOD_TYPE
columns.description: Accounting period type. Examples are Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly.

columns.name: PERIOD_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Accounting period type identifier.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Accounting calendar description.

columns.name: SECURITY_FLAG
columns.description: Security mode flag of the calendar.

columns.name: NON_ADJ_PERIOD_FREQ_CODE
columns.description: Nonadjustment period frequency.

columns.name: ADJ_PERIOD_FREQ_CODE
columns.description: Frequency of adjusting periods in a calendar year. For example, it can be one adjusting period at the end of the year, two adjusting periods at the end of the year, one at the beginning and one at the end of the year.

columns.name: ADJ_PERIODS_NUM
columns.description: Number of adjusting periods per year in an accounting calendar when users choose to specify their own adjusting period frequency rather than selecting from prespecified choices.

columns.name: LEGACY_RULES_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates whether legacy rules for migration apply to this calendar for update purposes. Valid values are Yes or No.

columns.name: NON_ADJ_PERIODS_NUM
columns.description: Number of nonadjustment periods.

columns.name: USER_PERIOD_NAME_PREFIX
columns.description: Optional string that is added at the beginning of an accounting period name, usually to identify its nature, such as fiscal or quarter name.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: To put in a fixed or organized form.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME_SEPARATOR_CODE
columns.description: Character (dash, forward slash, or none) that separates the period and year components of the accounting period name.

columns.name: LATEST_YEAR_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the latest year for which periods are generated.

columns.name: CALENDAR_START_DATE
columns.description: Date when the first period of the accounting calendar begins.

columns.name: CALENDAR_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of Calendar. Valid values are Accounting or Budgetary Control.

columns.name: LEGACY_CALENDAR_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates whether this is a legacy E-Business Suite calendar. Valid values are Yes or No.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Enterprise or business group identifier.

columns.name: DEFAULT_PARTITION_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Default partition grouping used for ledgers with this calendar.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.
